record.paper_title: Open questions for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics
record.original_question: Let the bar operator on symmetric functions be defined by sending s_mu(x) to s_mu_bar(x), where mu_bar is obtained from the partition mu by removing its first column, and extending linearly. For all positive integers m and n, prove the transpose Schur inclusions q^alpha' bar(e_{m,n-1}(x;q,t)) <=_s e_{m,n}(x;q,t) and q^beta' bar(e_{m,n-1}(x;q,t)) <=_s h_hat_{m,n}(x;q,t), where alpha' and beta' are the staircase-counting exponents described for the transpose versions of the inclusions.

evidence.quote: Question. 4. Can we prove that, for all pair m, n ≥ 1, the Schur inclu-sions (16) and (19) hold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in the ring of symmetric functions in variables $x = (x_1, x_2, \dots)$ over $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$, with Schur basis $\{s_\mu(x)\}$. For a partition $\mu$, let $\bar\mu$ denote the partition obtained from $\mu$ by removing its first column. Define the linear "bar" operator on symmetric functions by
$$ \overline{\,\cdot\,} : s_\mu(x) \longmapsto s_{\bar\mu}(x), $$
extended linearly to all symmetric functions.

For positive integers $m,n$, let $e_{m,n}(x;q,t)$ and $h_{m,n}(x;q,t)$ denote the rectangular Catalan symmetric functions obtained by applying the corresponding elliptic Hall algebra / shuffle algebra operator indexed by the lattice point $(m,n)$ to the constant $1$, and set
$$ \widehat{h}_{m,n}(x;q,t) := \omega\, e_{m,n}(x;q,t), $$
where $\omega$ is the standard involution $s_\mu \mapsto s_{\mu'}$.

For symmetric functions $f,g$ with coefficients in $\mathbb{N}[q,t]$, write $f \leq_s g$ to mean that $g - f$ is Schur-positive, i.e. lies in $\mathbb{N}[q,t]\{s_\mu\}$.

Let $\alpha'$ and $\beta'$ be the nonnegative integers defined as the number of lattice cells lying strictly above the staircase line from $(0,0)$ to $(m,n)$ in the two rectangular regions associated, respectively, to the transpose versions of the two inclusions below (so $q^{\alpha'}$ and $q^{\beta'}$ are the natural staircase-counting monomial shifts).

Prove that, for all integers $m,n \geq 1$,
$$ q^{\alpha'}\, \overline{e_{m,n-1}(x;q,t)} \;\leq_s\; e_{m,n}(x;q,t), $$
and
$$ q^{\beta'}\, \overline{e_{m,n-1}(x;q,t)} \;\leq_s\; \widehat{h}_{m,n}(x;q,t). $$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is one of a family of Schur-positivity/inclusion conjectures for rectangular Catalan operators. Subsequent work on Catalan functions and k-Schur positivity (e.g. Blasiak–Morse–Pun–Summers) has resolved several related positivity conjectures, but the specific transpose Schur inclusions involving the bar operator and the staircase-shift exponents do not appear to have been proved in the literature found; they remain open as far as the search reveals.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates open questions regarding Schur positivity of operators on symmetric functions related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics.
status_evidence.claim: The transpose Schur inclusions appear as an explicitly stated open question.

status_evidence.title: Catalan functions and k-Schur positivity
status_evidence.snippet: Resolves Schur and k-Schur positivity conjectures for Catalan functions via strong marked tableaux.
status_evidence.claim: Related Schur-positivity conjectures for Catalan functions have been resolved, but not specifically the bar-operator transpose inclusions.
